Hezbollah and all other non-state armed groups must be fully and verifiably disarmed. 5. Israel affirms it has no territorial ambitions in Lebanon and will withdraw once security threats are resolved. 6. Lebanon reaffirms the state’s exclusive authority to maintain armed forces and declare war. 7. A US-backed coordination and verification mechanism will oversee implementation. 8. Both parties commit to a sovereign, stable Lebanon free from armed groups threatening either side. 9. The US will support and strengthen the Lebanese Armed Forces, with assistance tied to verified progress. 10. The US will lead coordination of international reconstruction, humanitarian aid, and economic recovery efforts. 11. Lebanon and the US will ensure that aid and reconstruction funds do not reach Hezbollah or other armed groups. 12. Israel and Lebanon will establish working groups to negotiate a comprehensive peace and security framework. 13. Both sides will cease hostile political and legal actions and cooperate on the return of detainees and remains. 14. Israel and Lebanon acknowledge the US role and express appreciation for President Donald Trump’s leadership.

headline: U.S. aircraft struck Iranian missile and drone storage locations and coastal radar sites today after Iran hit the M/V Ever Lovely, a Singapore-flagged cargo ship, with a one-way attack drone on June 25. The vessel was exiting the Strait of Hormuz along the Omani coast. CENTCOM said the attack on commercial shipping clearly violated the ceasefire and undermined freedom of navigation through the vital trade corridor. U.S. forces continue providing safe passage coordination for commercial vessels transiting the strait and remain vigilant to ensure all aspects of the agreement with Iran are enforced.
